entities.name: Frontier Capital
entities.researchNotes: Next Frontier Capital (NFC) - early-stage VC firm founded 2015. Thesis: 'exceptional talent and innovation exist beyond traditional venture capital hubs on the coasts.' Partners with mission-driven founders building companies of impact in Montana and Mountain West. Now manages $250M across four funds. Fund IV ($102M) focuses on: AI/Data, Cybersecurity, B2B Software, Climate/Clean Energy, Defense Tech, Deep Tech. Seed-stage: $2M-$5M checks, Series A: $8M-$15M follow-ons. Collaborative partnership model, 4-8 week decision timeline. Strong lead tendency.

entities.name: Governance Fund
entities.researchNotes: Note: 'Governance Fund' as a specific VC firm was not found in research. However, AI governance-focused investing is a major emerging theme. Key developments: RAIVC (Responsible AI Venture Council) at Santa Clara University, Project Liberty Institute with ReframeVenture and ImpactVC providing VC toolkits for responsible AI. 60% of executives report responsible AI boosts ROI. Top AI safety investors: Lightspeed (4 deals, $2B), Sequoia (3 deals, $3B+), Evolution Equity Partners. AI safety funding: $398M (2024), $214M (2025). Recommended pivot: target RAIVC-adjacent firms or AI governance-focused VCs like those backing Anthropic/OpenAI safety initiatives.
